simple.meaning: יִלּוֹד (yillôwd) is a Hebrew word meaning “born.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: יִלּוֹד (H3209) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Exodus 1:22, with occurrences in Exodus, Joshua, 2 Samuel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יִלּוֹד (H3209) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יִלּוֹד (H3209) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: יִלּוֹד (yillôwd) / H3209 is traced through Exodus 1:22, Joshua 5:5, 2 Samuel 5:14, 2 Samuel 12:14 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
